gorak.entrance.0.text: They chained me. They starved me. They threw me in the pit with three bears. Now the bears are a rug, and I am Gorak the Skullsplitter.

gorak.entrance.1.text: Ten winters I have walked into this sand, and ten winters I have walked out. Count your bones, little champion. I will be counting them after.

gorak.victory.0.text: Who is next? Send two. Send ten!

gorak.victory.1.text: Write it in the sand. Gorak. Still. Standing.

aldric.entrance.0.text: I am Aldric, called Ironwall, captain of the Ninth Shield. I held the Gray Bridge for three days against an army. Today I need only hold this sand.

aldric.entrance.1.text: The light does not ask whether you are ready. It simply arrives. Kneel now, and I will remember you kindly.

aldric.victory.0.text: The Ninth Shield holds. Mark it in the records.

aldric.victory.1.text: Rise again in a better life, champion.

ozrel.entrance.0.text: They called it an accident. The academy, the library, the dean. I call it a lesson. I am Ozrel the Cinderlord, and class is in session.

ozrel.entrance.1.text: Do you smell that? Smoke. Ash. Opportunity. Ha ha ha! Stand still, and I promise it will only hurt forever.

ozrel.victory.0.text: Note to self: champions burn slower than books.

ozrel.victory.1.text: Applause! Or I set the stands on fire.

erika.entrance.0.text: I have tracked wolves through blizzards and kings through their own castles. They call me the Thornshot. I never miss the same target twice. I have never needed to.

erika.entrance.1.text: Quiet now. Listen. That is your heart. Count the beats you have left, champion. I already have.

erika.victory.0.text: Another trophy. The wall is getting crowded.

erika.victory.1.text: The forest remembers. So will they.

vex.entrance.0.text: Do you hear it? Thousands of hearts, racing for me. I have been dead for three hundred years, and I have never felt more alive. I am Vex, the Crimson Whisper.

vex.entrance.1.text: Come, champion. Let me show you what eternity feels like. It is shorter than you think.

vex.victory.0.text: The crowd adores me. Of course they do.

fenrik.entrance.0.text: Cellar. Dark. Needles. They made me. Now I unmake them. Fenrik. Bloodmaw. Hungry.

fenrik.entrance.1.text: Smell you. Smell fear. Run. Fenrik likes when they run.

maw.entrance.0.text: One hundred years beneath your arena. Chains. Dark. Silence. Now the gate is open. Maw is hungry. Maw. Is. Free.

maw.entrance.1.text: You build walls. You build cages. Maw eats walls. Maw eats cages. Maw will eat you.

maw.victory.1.text: Back to the dark? No. Maw stays.

hollowjack.entrance.0.text: Harvest time, harvest time, who is ripe for harvest time? Hee hee! I am Hollowjack, the Pumpkin Hulk, and I lift. Your. SPIRITS. Right out of your body!

hollowjack.entrance.1.text: They carved me a smile so I would never stop grinning. Thanks for that! It makes the stomping so much more cheerful!

gorak.faceoff.0.text: You are smaller than they promised.

gorak.faceoff.1.text: Pray loud. The gods are far away and I am very close.

gorak.taunt.0.text: Is that all? My grandmother hits harder, and she is dead.

gorak.taunt.1.text: Come closer! The axe is lonely.

gorak.nearDeath.0.text: Not yet. Gorak does not fall to worms.

gorak.nearDeath.1.text: Blood in my eyes. Good. Now I see red.

gorak.comeback.0.text: You woke me up. Bad idea.

gorak.defeat.0.text: Tell them... I did not run...

gorak.vs_aldric.0.text: Shiny man. I will make your shield into a soup bowl.

aldric.faceoff.0.text: Your sins are written on your face. I will read them aloud.

aldric.faceoff.1.text: Raise your guard. I insist on a fair execution.

aldric.taunt.0.text: Is that the best your gods can muster?

aldric.taunt.1.text: Strike true, or do not strike at all.

aldric.taunt.2.text: I have felt sharper words from novices.

aldric.nearDeath.0.text: The wall bends... it does not break.

aldric.nearDeath.1.text: Light, give me one more breath.

aldric.comeback.0.text: The tide turns. As it always does.

aldric.comeback.1.text: You mistook my patience for weakness.

aldric.vs_gorak.0.text: Your axe has widowed half the north, warlord. It ends on this sand.

aldric.vs_vex.0.text: I know what you are, bloodsucker. Holy steel remembers your kind.

ozrel.faceoff.0.text: Oh, you are flammable. How delightful.

ozrel.faceoff.1.text: Let us see what you are made of. Mostly carbon, I suspect.

ozrel.taunt.0.text: Warm enough for you? Ha ha!

ozrel.taunt.2.text: I have burned better scholars than you.

ozrel.nearDeath.0.text: Close. So close to the final lecture.

ozrel.nearDeath.1.text: If I go, I take the whole arena with me!

ozrel.comeback.0.text: The fire was never out. Merely sleeping!

ozrel.vs_hollowjack.0.text: A pumpkin? Oh, I am going to carve you a lovely new face.

erika.faceoff.1.text: I have your scent. There is nowhere left to run.

erika.taunt.2.text: You fight like a wounded boar.

erika.nearDeath.1.text: Not like this. Not to you.

erika.defeat.0.text: I should have... kept my distance...

erika.vs_vex.0.text: I have hunted your kind for nine years, vampire. Silver tips, just for you.

vex.faceoff.1.text: Such a strong heartbeat. Let us see how long it lasts.

vex.nearDeath.0.text: Not yet. The night is young.

vex.vs_erika.0.text: The little hunter again. I kept your last arrow. Shall I return it?

vex.vs_aldric.0.text: Your god abandoned me centuries ago, knight. He will not save you either.

fenrik.vs_maw.0.text: Big one. Old one. Fenrik eats you anyway.

maw.vs_fenrik.0.text: Little beast. Maw ate your kind for breakfast before your cellar was dug.

maw.vs_gorak.0.text: Loud man with axe. Maw swallowed louder.

hollowjack.faceoff.1.text: Hee hee! Do you want to see a magic trick? It is called flat.

hollowjack.defeat.1.text: Tell the patch... I said boo...

hollowjack.vs_ozrel.0.text: Fire man! You want to roast me? Join the queue!
